io.github.thebusybiscuit.sensibletoolbox.api.recipes

Class CustomRecipeManager

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.sensibletoolbox.api.recipes.CustomRecipeManager

  • public class CustomRecipeManager
extends java.lang.Object
    This class manages custom recipes known to STB. A custom recipe requires a machine (object which subclasses BaseSTBMachine) to produce the result. Custom recipes may be shaped (ShapedCustomRecipe) or more commonly shapeless (ShapelessCustomRecipe).
